analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see stance for the past 3 consecutive sessions. RSI is hovering in the neutral zone, and ADX at 11.1 indicates a weak trend formation. MACD histogram has worsened from 2.4309 to 1.4721, signaling a loss of upward momentum. The current price of $525.48 is nearly aligned with the SMA50 at $525.20, approaching resistance. The volume ratio of 0.19 relative to the 5-day average suggests a lack of conviction in the price action. ATR volatility stands at $16.72, representing 3.18% of the current price.
